entrypoints.name: reindex_file / reindex_file_impl
entrypoints.registration: MCP tool 'reindex_file' (server.py:1161, _wrap_tool maintenance=True); MCP tool 'reindex_file' is the post-edit update path the LLM agent calls
entrypoints.semantic_indexing_behavior: Single-file re-parse: extract_all for matching TUs. In normal M6 mode (default): _resolve_context returns legacy index.db path; since index.db is NEVER created in normal mode (runner.run only opens it under _legacy_compat_on()=False), db_path.exists() is False → _reindex_m6_direct branch → materialize_unit_into_m6. In compat mode (index.db exists): _reindex_parse_and_store calls store_symbols_for_unit + certify_and_publish_for_unit (writes index-v2.db only, NOT index-m6.db) — this legacy branch does NOT materialize to M6, but is unreachable in normal mode.
entrypoints.classification_evidence: M7-FINAL-ECONOMIC-ADDENDUM fix (§6): added _reindex_m6_direct() at maintenance.py:2072. In normal M6 mode, db_path.exists() is False (index.db not created) so _reindex_m6_direct runs → materialize_unit_into_m6(). Verified GREEN by test_reindex_file_m6_direct_green.py. The legacy-DB branch (_reindex_parse_and_store) only runs when index.db exists (compat opt-in or pre-M5 upgrade scenario) — NOT normal production.
